title: Amoudo 15.6" 1920x1080 IPS Portable Monitor US$46.32 (~A$65.57) AU Stock Delivered @ amoudo Overseas Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: Amoudo 15.6" 1920x1080 IPS Portable Monitor US$46.32 (~A$65.57) AU Stock Delivered @ amoudo Overseas Store AliExpress

[gunnerz] Any recommendations for a touch screen compatible monitor?
[deeevan] A blessing in disguise my last paste from the Share button was unpublished, found a cheaper one.
I have the 14" version of this. The 14" had a model number SZF which I took to mean it's a rebadge of the SZF popular on Ozb. YMMV with the 15.6". USD$73.88 after coupon
https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005012035797317.html
[Blitzfx] The touch display in your link comes out to USD$46.92 with the AUNS06 coupon.
Is that the right display?
[Dogstar] No, that's the non touch version. Touch is showing over $100 for me.
[Blitzfx] @Dogstar: Whoops. Didn't notice that.
Comparing the two displays (non-touch ver), the HGFRTEE version has 3ms response time vs the amoudo 6ms, brightness 300cd/m vs 1000cd/m, and contrast 800:1 vs 1000:1
The deal description for amoudo's brightness is incorrect. should be 1000 according to the specification down the page
[deeevan] @Blitzfx: I take all AliExpress portable monitor specs besides size/resolution with a grain of salt. I expect they all look terrible at an angle or in bright light.
[syousef] 66% sRGB. No thanks. Colours will be awful and likely to have banding. The Amoundo has 100% sRGB supposedly but is 6 bit + FRC so um yeah….I dunno. Price is good so maybe I'm just too picky.
[MistaL] I got this one last time and the one I was sent looks exactly like the picture but doesn't have speakers (just in case anyone needs the speakers)
[Bob Wang] @MistaL Thanks for the headsup, would it be MacOS compatible? thanks in advance.
[Clear] It's just a monitor, so no issues connecting.
[ransworld] I just paid for this using PayPal and was charged twice… Only one order in my Aliexpress account, one charge in my PayPal account, but two charges in my bank account.
[epitone] I was also charged a second charge of $1 USD. It might just be a card verification test.
[ransworld] In my case it was a second $64.58 pending charge, but it seems to have been sorted now.
[Jackson] I picked up a similar device from a bloke who sells Amazon returns for 40 bucks, since I have been using pixel desktop it's been a bit of a revelation, very easy to dock on your desk with the 2 dollar port replicator from a month or two back and it's nice to know that when you leave your desk everything you were doing is still in your pocket. I don't know why more people don't do it, although professionally I obviously can't run all the work apps I would typically need but I am fine with it at home
Thanks Clear for letting me know what the micro USB was for, didn't realise it was for OTG, confused as to why they make it micro USB tho? How many micro USB devices do people have these days?
[vrsac] Very Interesting!
Which portable monitor do you use? I'd also like to use it with my Pixel phone in a desktop mode. Thanks.
[nonofyourbusiness] Would this kind of monitor be a good option for a security camera NVR? I won't have this on all the time, only when need to look into it.
Thanks!
[siggy213] Dunno why the bot claimed my other message.
Yes you can but i used a dif brand.
Search aliexpress and search for “USB to Type C Switch Cable, DC 5V 2A Power Supply Extension Wire with On/Off Button, Electrical Line for Phone Lamp and LED Light’’
Make sure you invest in a decent power brick too.
Since my comms rack had a clear front i mounted it on the inside facing out. I just press a button to view and then turn it off.
